canonical_term: Nebraska Review of Blight and Substandard Designations
summary: Authorizes a city governing body to review substandard, blighted, or extremely blighted area designations and remove a designation by resolution if the area no longer qualifies, without invalidating previously approved projects or related debt.
plain_language: A city can revisit whether an old blight designation still fits, but that does not undo already-approved projects.

facts.object: governing body may review designated area at any time
governing body may remove designation by resolution if the area is no longer eligible
removal does not affect validity of approved plans, projects, bonds, contracts, or agreements approved before removal

relationships.note: Micro-TIF eligibility depends on qualifying substandard and blighted area context.
